the assessment tools (AT) used in pediatric rehabilitation of children with CNS tumors are fragmented, and the ATs developed for children with brain tumors are scarce.

there is a need to develop and to validate a global multidimension AT for children with brain tumor, overcoming the fragmented assessment procedures and promoting the use of standardized rehabilitation protocols in this population.
the assessment of children with central neurooncology tumors is not well standardized, and that a global multidimensional tool for the assessment of these patients is needed.
